title.en: Mortality rates: crude and specific death rates
title.kn: ಮರಣ ದರಗಳು: ಸ್ಥೂಲ ಮತ್ತು ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ಮರಣ ದರ

hook.en: A retirement town and a college town both had 400 deaths last year. Are they equally healthy? We need death rates, not just death counts.
hook.kn: ನಿವೃತ್ತರ ಪಟ್ಟಣ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾಲೇಜು ಪಟ್ಟಣ ಎರಡರಲ್ಲೂ ಕಳೆದ ವರ್ಷ 400 ಮರಣಗಳಾದವು. ಎರಡೂ ಸಮಾನ ಆರೋಗ್ಯಕರವೇ? ನಮಗೆ ಮರಣ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯಲ್ಲ, ಮರಣ ದರ ಬೇಕು.

objectives.en: State merits and demerits of CDR

narration.en: A retirement town and a college town both had 400 deaths last year. Are they equally healthy? We need death rates, not just death counts.
narration.kn: ನಿವೃತ್ತರ ಪಟ್ಟಣ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾಲೇಜು ಪಟ್ಟಣ ಎರಡರಲ್ಲೂ ಕಳೆದ ವರ್ಷ 400 ಮರಣಗಳಾದವು. ಎರಡೂ ಸಮಾನ ಆರೋಗ್ಯಕರವೇ? ನಮಗೆ ಮರಣ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯಲ್ಲ, ಮರಣ ದರ ಬೇಕು.

body.en: The crude death rate is the number of deaths in a year per 1000 of the mid-year population: $\text{CDR} = \frac{D}{P} \times 1000$. Merits: simple, needs only total deaths and total population. Demerit: it ignores the age and sex composition, so it is not suitable for comparing two places with different age structures.

points.en: Merit: easy to compute and understand
Not fit for comparing two regions

narration.en: Crude death rate is deaths divided by mid-year population, times one thousand. It is simple, but it ignores the age and sex composition.
narration.kn: ಸ್ಥೂಲ ಮರಣ ದರ = ಮರಣಗಳು ÷ ಮಧ್ಯವರ್ಷದ ಜನಸಂಖ್ಯೆ × 1000. ಇದು ಸರಳ, ಆದರೆ ವಯಸ್ಸು ಮತ್ತು ಲಿಂಗ ಸಂಯೋಜನೆಯನ್ನು ಕಡೆಗಣಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: From specific rates to the crude rate

narration.en: The board builds the specific death rates from a table, then the crude death rate, and shows that the crude rate is a weighted mean.

say.en: Here is a town split into four age groups, with the population and deaths of each.
Specific death rate of each group: deaths over population, times one thousand.
The crude death rate uses the totals: four hundred sixty deaths in thirty thousand people.
Notice: CDR is the weighted mean of the SDRs, weighted by population. It is not the simple mean of the four SDRs.

body.en: A specific death rate is the death rate of a particular section of the population, for example an age group: $\text{SDR}_x = \frac{D_x}{P_x} \times 1000$. SDRs show where mortality is high (infants and the old). The CDR is the weighted mean of the SDRs with the group populations as weights: $\text{CDR} = \frac{\sum P_x\,\text{SDR}_x}{\sum P_x}$.

points.en: SDRs are high for infants and the aged

narration.en: A specific death rate is the death rate of one age group: deaths in the group over the population of the group, times one thousand. The crude rate is the weighted average of the specific rates.
narration.kn: ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ಮರಣ ದರ ಎಂದರೆ ಒಂದು ವಯೋಗುಂಪಿನ ಮರಣ ದರ: ಆ ಗುಂಪಿನ ಮರಣಗಳು ÷ ಆ ಗುಂಪಿನ ಜನಸಂಖ್ಯೆ × 1000. ಸ್ಥೂಲ ದರವು ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ದರಗಳ ತೂಕಿತ ಸರಾಸರಿ.

caption.en: The bars are the specific death rates of four age groups. Change the size of the 50+ group and its death rate, and watch the crude death rate.

tryThis.en: Keep the SDR at 50 and increase the 50+ population. Why does CDR rise even though no group became less healthy?
Set the 50+ population to 1000. How low does the CDR go?

narration.en: The crude death rate depends on the age composition as well as on the specific rates. Try it with the sliders.

body.en: Never average the SDRs directly. Multiply each SDR by its population, add, and divide by the total population: you get back total deaths over total population.

narration.en: CDR is a weighted mean. Never average the SDRs directly. Multiply each SDR by its population, add, and divide by the total population: you get back total deaths over total population.

mnemonic.en: Weight by People, not by Groups
